See without eyes.name: See without eyes
See without eyes.special: If cannot see opponent, penalites are reduced to -4 melee. Gain full defensive modifer against their attacks. Ignores distortion spell effects. Does not apply if target is silenced.

Flow as water.name: Flow as water
Flow as water.special: -6 Defensive modifier. Dodge, Feint and Sidestep are +30%. Offensive actions are -2 to hit, and speed is +1 second.

Strike as wind.name: Strike as wind
Strike as wind.special: +3 Melee/Missile to hit, Starting weapon speeds are -1 second. Initiative is -2, Critical, Focused Attack, Perfect Shot are +20%.

Calm in the storm.name: Calm in the storm
Calm in the storm.special: +25% resistances effects which hold or affect movement. +10% Control Resistance. Parries, Disarm and Trap Weapon are +10%, AGL Saves are +20%.

Drunken fighting.name: Drunken fighting
Drunken fighting.special: +2 to hit and +1 per die of damage after failing 1 VIT Save for intoxication. +10% to combat skills and Martial Knowledge attacks. If more than 3 VIT Saves for intoxication all modifers are lost.
